data.one_liner: Flutter package providing a collection of Iconsax icons in multiple styles.
data.what_it_does: Adds the Iconsax icon set to a Flutter project, offering Linear, Bulk, Two Tone, Bold, Outline, and Broken styles. Icons can be used directly with the standard Icon widget.
use_when: You need a large variety of custom icons beyond the built‑in Material icons
You want to keep a consistent Iconsax visual language across iOS, Android, web and desktop
avoid_when: You already use another icon pack and want to minimise bundle size
You require icons that can be dynamically themed or recolored beyond what Iconsax provides
strengths: Wide range of icon styles in a single package
Simple API – use with the standard Icon widget
No additional build steps or code generation required
weaknesses: Increases app size with a large icon font
Limited to the Iconsax set – no custom icon creation

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a popular, extensive icon set with similar easy‑to‑use API

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a modern, open‑source icon collection as an alternative to Iconsax

alternatives.name: material_symbols_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: Uses Google’s Material Symbols, which may already be familiar and reduce extra assets
